visualReview.notes: Inspected54 final current frames:12 portable,12 shared-material/flat-map and30 Earth-rig/native-field/tier views. Complete original Grand Lisboa exterior retains the narrow-waisted curved rear hotel shaft,seven distinct curling leaf tiers per side/front-back set,stepped lower tower podium,ogive crown with a visible diamond band,globe/open finial and261m total target. The front flattened ovoid has geometric triangular mirrored cells,inset seams and master recess returns. Paired side annex drums/terraces,blank sign pylon,pointed arches and an actual near foyer aperture complete the individual model. Exact Q1033099 lower-parent identity and separate210m hotel footprint sign the asymmetric layout;the55m parent is the casino,not the full261m landmark. Retained heading0.770950765704;internal originX15.25,Z−12.25 and45degree design rotation align the main hotel face approximately east/west,casino/entry south. Visual iteration repaired the missing lower pedestal,removed the base strip obstructing the arcade,separated successive leaf tips,exposed the crown diamond band and corrected the mirrored-cladding material slot. Cladding now uses the tinted wall variant,so authored gold/silver/slate/cyan triangular colors survive shared binding;the procedural window variant intentionally uses the standard untinted catalog grid. Five existing256px bronze/gold,window-grid,polished-stainless,painted-metal and granite graphs plus palette blank sign add no private or embedded images. Master preserves denser curved leaves/floor bands,moldings,crown ribs and shell returns. Four browser tiers preserve the complete unique silhouette;far tiers aggregate front/back leaf depth,entrance openings and small details. Four focused tests prove exact source reconstruction,signed placement,native granite arch-foot contacts,connected pedestal,narrow waist,expanded fan,visible first leaf tip/gap,ovoid/crown heights,real near doorway,and exact tier budgets/separate GPU streams/tint-preserving cladding slots/colors. Production viewer removes both actual lower-parent and tower polygons while preserving four neighboring native buildings. Unmodified129x129/2m field oversamples one ordinary global urban DEM tile;its returns vary noticeably across the site. Base11m and original street/foundation/accessible-entry grades remain approximate. Skirts and sampled arch-foot blocks embed into that field;native ground remains visible through the entry. Curved depths,individual leaf/floor/panel inventories,annex/podium/pylon sections and crown/finial ornament are photographic reconstructions rather than exact surveyed replicas. Triangular palette pattern is original,not a panel-by-panel photo copy. Opaque reflective/glass surfaces exclude optical interiors;billboard content and surrounding city context are excluded. Portable fallback and shared viewer appearances differ. Generic synthetic close cameras can show only part of the facade;custom whole-landmark/detail and explicit four-tier views establish coverage. Minor shadow/facet/LOD differences and physical-device timing remain unmeasured.

Base11m is rounded from its center and remains approximate. Native ground remains visible through entry openings. Actual original foundation,curb,accessible-entry gradients and street levels are unsurveyed. Both actual lower-parent/hotel polygons are replaced in the production viewer fixture;four neighboring native buildings remain.
